# VoxelReport

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Stats` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public static class VoxelReport
```

Reports whether an archive's artwork can be turned into a voxel model, and where it cannot.

## Remarks

Partial alpha is **allowed**: the editor's opacity lock is a default an author may turn off deliberately, so this is a report and not a [`Validator`](Nfty.Core.Formats.Validator.md) problem. A semi-transparent pixel is simply not answerable as a voxel — a converter has to drop it or make it solid, and either way the result is not what was drawn. This says which pixels those are before someone finds out downstream.

Rendered here rather than in a front-end for the reason every report in this namespace is: the CLI and the GUI must show the same text, and two copies is how that stops being true. The format is invariant — these get pasted into issues and diffed across machines.

It costs a full scan of every variant image, which is why nothing runs it implicitly.
